summary: @servicetitan/widget-platform-monolith preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727 KB payload
details: On `npm install`, the package's preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip`, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` to run `math_init.js` — a 727 KB single-line, string-array-obfuscated Bun-cjs bundle shipped in the tarball. The payload has no source counterpart in `src/`, no documented purpose, and no readable strings (numeric cipher table plus a string-array rotator). The package is advertised as a React widget library, and neither Bun nor the opaque loader is required for that purpose; the alternate-runtime pattern also causes the payload to execute outside the Node-resolved code path most tooling inspects. The package publishes under the `@servicetitan` scope and declares `@servicetitan/widget-platform` as its sole runtime dependency, mirroring the naming shape used in dependency-confusion attacks against that organization.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
